title: Xetrieval: Explaining Dense Retrieval through Feature Elicitation
abstract: arXiv:2605.29507v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dense retrieval enables effective semantic matching, yet the semantic factors underlying its relevance scores remain opaque. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) support feature-level explanations by decomposing dense embeddings into sparse semantic features. However, the document semantics underlying a retriever's relevance scores may not be sufficiently explicit in the embeddings to be recovered as interpretable SAE features. We introduce Xetrieval, a framework for explaining dense retrieval through feature elicitation. Feature Elicitors make retrieval-relevant aspects of document meaning more explicit through auxiliary views, facilitating their identification as interpretable SAE features. A shared sparse dictionary learns from these varied representations to express query--document relations through describable features. We assess their influence on relevance scores through interventions on the original document embeddings. Experimen

translated_title: Xetrieval：通过特征引出解释稠密检索
translated_abstract: 稠密检索能够实现有效的语义匹配，但其相关性得分背后的语义因素仍然是不透明的。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）通过将稠密嵌入分解为稀疏语义特征，为特征层面的解释提供了支持。然而，检索器相关性得分所依据的文档语义在嵌入中可能不够显式，难以被恢复为可解释的SAE特征。我们提出了Xetrieval，一个通过特征引出（feature elicitation）来解释稠密检索的框架。特征引出器通过辅助视图使文档含义中与检索相关的方面更加显式，从而便于将其识别为可解释的SAE特征。一个共享的稀疏字典从这些多样化的表示中学习，通过可描述的特征来表达查询与文档之间的关系。我们通过对原始文档嵌入进行干预来评估这些特征对相关性得分的影响……
tldr: 提出Xetrieval框架，通过特征引出器生成辅助视图使文档中与检索相关的语义更加显式，并借助共享稀疏字典以可解释的SAE特征表达查询-文档关系，从而解释稠密检索的相关性得分。
en_tdlr: Xetrieval is a framework that explains dense retrieval by eliciting retrieval-relevant document semantics through auxiliary views and expressing query–document relations with interpretable SAE features learned in a shared sparse dictionary.
